Exercise B

Present Perfect with Since & For

Choose the correct word. Use since with a point in time (since 2019) and for with a period of time (for ten years).

Complete the Sentence

1. I lived in Arizona for five years.

2. She visited the Grand Canyon twice.

3. We have known each other 2019.

4. They have lived here ten years.

5. Ellen Ochoa inspired many young people.

6. I have been to New Mexico.

7. He has worked in the same town he was young.

8. Have you eaten Mexican food?

Exercise C

Writing: Your Experiences

Write about your own experiences (6–8 sentences). Say what you have done, where you have been, and how long you have lived somewhere. Use the present perfect with since and for.

Useful language
You can use these: I have lived I have been to I have never since for ever for ... years since I was young
